plugins.name: koreader_mcp
plugins.description: Agent bridge for remote device management. While live mode is on, the device holds a connection to the gateway and answers file, command, status and UI calls over it. Send diagnostics uploads one bundle to the gateway inbox.

plugins.name: kosyncserverless
plugins.description: Synchronizes your reading progress to a server across your KOReader devices. A copy of the built-in Progress sync plugin for servers that sleep when idle.

plugins.name: pluginpackages
plugins.description: Install, upgrade and roll back plugins from a package host, including this one. Uses WiFi only when you open it.

plugins.name: rssreader
plugins.description: Read RSS feeds from local lists or online services.

plugins.name: syncedhistory
plugins.description: A reading list shared by every device logged into the same progress sync server. Opens the local copy of a book and pulls its latest position.
